title: India Becomes World's 4th-Largest Economy at $4.18 Trillion
summary: India surpassed Japan to become the world's 4th-largest economy with a $4.18 trillion GDP, targeting $7.3 trillion by 2030.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 India Becomes World's 4th-Largest Economy at $4.18 Trillion. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: India's nominal GDP touched **$4.18 trillion**, overtaking Japan to rank as the **4th-largest economy globally**. The 2030 target is to reach $7.3 trillion and become the 3rd-largest (surpassing Germany).
**Q2 FY26 Real GDP Growth**: 8.2% (up from 7.8% in Q1).
**2026 Agency Growth Forecasts**: World Bank 6.5%, IMF 6.2%, OECD 6.2%, Moody's 6.4%, ADB 7.2%, Fitch 7.4%.
Top 4 economies: US (1st), China (2nd), Germany (3rd), India (4th), Japan (5th).
